annotations.title: Competitor Intelligence, Feature Matrix & Moat Analyzer

description: Compiles multi-competitor comparison matrices, pricing tiers, feature coverage, and strategic moat evaluations. Use when analyzing market landscapes, evaluating pricing parity, or conducting diligence on competing product offerings; for compiling narrative research briefs, use compile_research_dossier instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'target_entity_or_market' ('analysis_framework' defaults to 'feature_and_pricing_matrix'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

analysis_framework.description: Benchmarking framework: feature and pricing matrix, SWOT competitive moat, or market share quadrant.

max_competitors.description: Maximum number of market competitors to profile and contrast.

target_entity_or_market.description: Industry sector, product category, or target company to benchmark against competitors.

name: compile_competitive_landscape

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for compile_competitive_landscape.

competitor_matrix.description: Structured matrix comparing market players, target customers, and offerings.

market_sector.description: Standardized market sector or product category analyzed.

pricing_comparison.description: Benchmarked pricing models, free tiers, and entry price points across players.

strategic_advantages.description: Identified competitive moats, network effects, and differentiation factors.

title: Competitor Intelligence, Feature Matrix & Moat Analyzer
